summary: Recent changes in the integration of **WebRTC**, the technology behind video calls, focus on enhancing performance and streamlining processes to ensure a smoother user experience. The update to the RTCRtpSender now prevents unnecessary data transmission fluctuations when a sender is inactive, which should lead to more efficient bandwidth usage. Additionally, modifications involving the removal of H.264 Access Unit Delimiter NALs (Network Abstraction Layer units) before decoding help improve video processing efficiency, ensuring better playback quality with less overhead. Together, these updates are designed to optimize video communication, which is increasingly vital in today's digital interactions.
